# TGA/DDS/ORM/HDR/EXR texture fixtures

All files in this directory are generated by `generate_textures.py` and are
repository-owned; no third-party asset or licence is involved. Regenerate with:

```powershell
python tests/fixtures/textures/generate_textures.py
```

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `tga24_uncompressed.tga` | 4x4 bottom-up 24-bit true-color |
| `tga32_uncompressed.tga` | 4x4 top-down 32-bit with alpha |
| `tga24_rle.tga` | 8x8 RLE 24-bit |
| `tga32_rle.tga` | 8x8 RLE 32-bit with alpha |
| `dds_bc1.dds`, `dds_bc3.dds`, `dds_bc5.dds`, `dds_bc7.dds` | one-mip block maps |
| `dds_bc1_mips.dds` | BC1 with a four-level authored chain |
| `dds_rgba8.dds` | uncompressed RGBA8, legacy masks |
| `dds_truncated.dds` | valid header, missing BC3 blocks |
| `package/` | OBJ + MTL using `albedo.tga` and `normal.dds` |
| `bad/` | OBJ + MTL naming an invalid `.tga` header |
| `orm/` | glTF with an ORM map where R=32, G=200, B=20 |
| `hdr_color.hdr` | 8x8 new-style RLE RGBE; (0,0) is linear 4.0/0.5/0.25 |
| `hdr_flat.hdr` | 4x4 flat RGBE scanlines |
| `hdr_bad_*.hdr`, `hdr_truncated.hdr` | malformed signature/format/resolution and truncation |
| `exr_color.exr` | 4x4 HALF RGB scanline, ZIP |
| `exr_float_rgba.exr` | 4x4 FLOAT RGBA scanline, uncompressed |
| `exr_normal.exr` | 4x4 HALF constant (0.5, 0.5, 1.0) normal map |
| `exr_roughness.exr` | 4x4 HALF single-channel `Y` roughness map, ZIPS |
| `exr_tiled/deep/multipart/piz/uint_channel/truncated.exr` | rejected forms |
| `exr/` | OBJ + MTL using EXR base colour and normal maps |
| `exr-gltf/` | glTF with EXR sidecar base colour and normal maps |
| `bad-exr/` | OBJ + MTL naming a truncated EXR |

Tests: `tests/import-isolation/TextureTgaDdsTests.cpp` (`[texture-tga]`,
`[texture-dds]`, `[texture-ao]`), `tests/import-isolation/TextureHdrExrTests.cpp`
(`[texture-hdr]`, `[texture-exr]`) and the shader-contract case in
`tests/unit/PresentationTests.cpp` (`[texture-ao]`).
